Hindi text-to-phoneme converter used by the book reader's "listen" voice in the browser.

From the npm package @diffusionstudio/piper-wasm, version 1.0.0
  https://github.com/diffusionstudio/piper-wasm   (package licence label: MIT)

It is a WebAssembly build of:
  piper-phonemize   (MIT)                  https://github.com/rhasspy/piper-phonemize
  eSpeak NG         (GPL-3.0-or-later)     https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng
Because it contains eSpeak NG, this converter is distributed under the GNU General Public License,
version 3 or later: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt
The source code is available at the addresses above.

Changed for this site (2026-11-27): piper_phonemize.data holds only the eSpeak NG data needed for
Hindi and English, and the file table inside piper_phonemize.js was rewritten to match. The program
itself (piper_phonemize.wasm) is unchanged.
